entries.title: Four ways a guard can be present without working
entries.summary: A reuse-before-write audit that refuses to say "nothing already implements this" when it could not see synonyms, could not prove the index complete, or found only dead code. Not exposed as a tool — the catalog moratorium holds at 91. It imported clean and had **four defects on first execution**, three of them a check that could not observe the thing it claimed to check.

entries.title: What the guard could not see
entries.summary: `build` and `.build` were both excluded from indexing. `_build` was not — and that is the spelling **Elixir/Mix, Sphinx and Dune** use. We index Elixir.
